verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs show some many-items-at-once capability: the published API spec lists a batches endpoint, the coding agent is pitched for multi-file refactoring, and the file-QA guide supports multi-file question answering. Each of these is only a brief mention, so the depth of bulk operation support is unproven. Missing for 10: documented batch API usage and limits, bulk actions in the assistant app itself, hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
